authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Bashkarik mīš/mī̃š young man/husband, with plural mānuš, in the manuṣya family. The survey mīʔś matches this shortened Bashkarik singular; the glottal marker is preserved.
